notes.title: The future of Tamashii
notes.notes:
it's time for a new chapter on the Tamashii's saga. 
Teocida is a sequel and a prequel that is more ugly, dirty, and experimental than the first game.
New puzzles and mechanics, new foes, and new secrets.

Why it's named Teocida and not Tamashii2?
     Teocida has a slight change of direction, a new playable character and it can be playable before or after Tamashii. You don't need to play them in order, but both games present a different perspective.

"How long the game will be?"
    I'm still focusing on making it a short experience (but it's already longer than Tamashii). 

"It's more spooky than Tamashii?"
    Tamashii is a cute game, not spooky at all :P

"The new game will scream at me at random?"
   No... At least not like in Tamashii. Teocida has a new few tricks.

I'm still working on Teocida (no release date yet), but you can read more about it and wishlist it here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1569470/Teocida/]Teocida Page[/url]

notes.title: TAMASHII nominated for Brazilian game of the year and about to hit consoles!
notes.notes:
Hi folks. Vikintor here.
2019 Was such a crazy ride. 

When I started working on Tamashii, my idea was about crafting a short experience that resonates with me, something very personal. A digital piece of art about subversive philosophy and transgressive metaphysics. 

My inspiration: Obscure videogames; that kind of game that wants to show a concept, to make an artistic point, a way of expressing their creator's minds, ideas, dreams, and nightmares. 
and I'm glad you enjoyed my weird tiny metaphysical nightmare.

Now the news:

Tamashii was nominated for 'Brazilian game of the year' at BGA (Brazil game awards), but even with the results not being out yet, I'm already glad to see how much Tamashii made so far. I never expected it being liked by so many neophytes. ♥

Also, a console edition is about to hit stores this year thanks to Digerati and StageClear Studios. 
Xbox One, PS4 and Nintendo Switch will get the game. 
This means you can turn this Christmas into a twisted Halloween.

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. Sorry for the delay, the 1.5 update is online bringing some fixes. (1.4 already solve the crashes on Beriah's chamber)

In this update:

* Pausing the game and choosing to "return to level select" no longer transports the player to level portal. Now you're transported to "Continue portal" instead.
* Choosing to disable image effects and animations no longer locks player on "Flesh Hub sequence" (or jumpscare).
* Minor fixes (texts, code...etc).

;)

notes.title: Tamashii is an aggressively unsettling horror platformer
notes.notes:
Horror is a genre I appreciate, but seldom gets under my skin the way it does for others. Tamashii, despite being a relatively simple-looking puzzle platformer, jangles my nerves like a dozen spiders crawling across my face. Released today and developed by Vikintor, I’ve had my eye on this one for a while after seeing some early footage on Twitter. The game has detailed, twisted sprites combined with some aggressive VHS-like and glitch effects that just makes my skin crawl, even if at its heart, it’s not too unusual as a game.
